2 فيّأ الظِلَّ , and ↓ افآءهُ He (God) made the shade to return [in the afternoon]. (El-Khafájee, MF, TA.) ＝
-A2- قَيَّأَت said of a tree: see 1, near the end. ―
-b2- Said of the wind, It put in motion the seed-produce, or standing corn, and the trees. (M, TA.) And, said of a woman, She put in motion her hair, from self-conceit, or vanity. (M, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
